name: banco-cad
description: Banco CAD: modellatore 3D parametrico per la scuola, in stile SolidWorks, in un'unica pagina HTML

scripts.test: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:kernel: node tests/extract.js index.html tests/core && node tests/kernel.test.js tests/core && node tests/step.test.js index.html tests/core && node tests/dwg.test.js convertitore-dwg/index.html tests/core && node tests/lingua.test.js index.html
scripts.test:lingua: TEST_LANG=check TEST_MISSING=tests/frasi-mancanti.json node tests/ui.test.js index.html && node tools/traduzione/mancanti.js tests/frasi-mancanti.json
